title: Account Holder KYC Document
description:
Describes the document and the required document image uploads
required to re-run KYC

token.description: Globally unique identifier for the document.

account_holder_token.description: Globally unique identifier for the account holder.

entity_token.description: Globally unique identifier for an entity.

required_document_uploads.description: Represents a single image of the document to upload.

items.description: Represents a single image of the document to upload.

status_reasons.description: Reasons for document image upload status.

upload_url.description:
URL to upload document image to.

Note that the upload URLs expire after 7 days. If an upload URL expires, you can
refresh the URLs by retrieving the document upload from `GET /account_holders/{account_holder_token}/documents`.

token.description: Globally unique identifier for the document upload.

accepted_entity_status_reasons.description: A list of status reasons associated with a KYB account holder that have been satisfied by the document upload

rejected_entity_status_reasons.description: A list of status reasons associated with a KYB account holder that have not been satisfied by the document upload

created.description: When the document upload was created

updated.description: When the document upload was last updated
